channel.title: ToolDune
channel.description: Free online tools: countdown timers, calculators, unit converters, text tools and generators.

item.title: HSA Contribution Calculator - 2026 Limits, Tax Savings and the Cap
item.description: The 2026 HSA limits by coverage and age, your real tax saving with payroll tax skipped, and a warning the moment you cross the cap. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: FSA Calculator - Tax Savings, Per-Paycheck Cost and Use-or-Lose Risk
item.description: Your FSA election becomes real tax saved at your bracket plus payroll tax, the per-paycheck dent, and exactly how much sits at use-or-lose risk. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: HDHP vs PPO Calculator - Which Health Plan Wins on Total Cost
item.description: Premiums, deductibles, expected care and the employer HSA seed become one verdict: which plan wins this year and where the crossover sits. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Electric vs Gas Heating Cost - Compare per Million BTU at Your Rates
item.description: Your electric and gas prices, furnace efficiency and heat pump COP become one verdict in dollars per million BTU - the honest way to rank heating fuels. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Generator Fuel Calculator - Gallons and Cost for Your Outage
item.description: Generator size, load and outage hours give the burn rate, total gallons, cost and cans to fill - with the refueling and backfeed rules that keep you safe. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: UPS Runtime Calculator - How Long Will a UPS Keep You Powered?
item.description: Enter your UPS size, the load it carries and battery age to estimate real runtime in minutes - and why the VA badge lies while the battery decides. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Power Outage Food Calculator - Is the Fridge Still Safe?
item.description: How long is food safe when the power is out? Hours out, freezer fullness and the fridge door give the federal 4-hour and 48-hour verdict: keep it, toss the fridge, or bin the thawed. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Generator Size Calculator - Running Watts Plus the Biggest Motor
item.description: What size generator do you need? Your running watts plus the largest motor surge give the right size in watts - with headroom and the two safety rules that outrank watts. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Space Heater Cost Calculator - Per Hour, Day and Month
item.description: What does a space heater cost to run? Wattage times hours times your electricity price gives the per-hour, daily and monthly cost - with the safety list. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Christmas Cactus Bloom Planner - Start Long Nights 8 Weeks Before
item.description: Why is your Christmas cactus not blooming? Pick a target date and get the night to start the 13-hour darkness treatment, cool nights and dry watering that force buds. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Bulb Planting Calculator - How Many Bulbs Fit Your Bed
item.description: How many tulip or daffodil bulbs for your bed? Bed size times spacing gives the count, packs of 25 to buy, planting depth and spacing by bulb type. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: First Frost Planner - Winterize Schedule Working Back from Your Date
item.description: Enter your average first frost date and get the winterizing schedule working backward: last feeding, tender pots inside, final harvest, hose drain and frost-night covers. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Tailgate Food Calculator - Meat, Sides and Drinks per Person
item.description: How much food for a tailgate? Adults, kids and meal style give pounds of raw meat, cups of sides and cans of drinks - a shopping list you can actually buy. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Cooler Ice Calculator - Pounds of Ice by Guests, Hours and Weather
item.description: How much ice for the cooler? Guests times hours plus weather and food give pounds of ice, 10 lb bags to buy and the cooler size in quarts. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Daylight Saving Sleep Planner - When Clocks Fall Back and How to Shift
item.description: Pick your region to see the exact fall-back date, then get a gentle bedtime shift plan - 10 to 20 minutes a day - so the time change lands without wrecking your week.

item.title: Pumpkin Seeds Roast Calculator - Yield, Servings and Roast Time
item.description: Enter your pumpkin weight to get cups of seeds, snack servings, oil and salt, and the roast time at 300 or 350 F - plus the simmer step most recipes skip that makes them crisp.

item.title: Pumpkin Carving Timing - The Right Day for a Fresh Jack-o-Lantern
item.description: Carve too early and your Jack-o-lantern sags by Halloween. Pick your preservation method and get the carving date that keeps it fresh for the night that matters.

item.title: Pumpkin Pie Calculator - How Many Pies for Your Guests
item.description: Enter guests and appetite to get pies, cups of puree, 15-oz cans, eggs and sugar - the full shopping math for one 9-inch pie feeding eight. Free, instant, no signup.

item.title: Firewood Seasoning Calculator - When Is Your Stack Ready to Burn?
item.description: Enter your split date and species to get the seasoning-ready month, plus cords in your stack from its footprint - and the tell-tale signs (crack, clack, hiss) that beat any calendar.

item.title: Fire Pit vs Patio Heater - Real Cost per Hour Compared
item.description: Wood fire pit, propane patio heater or electric infrared - enter your local prices and see the honest cost per hour of each, assumptions on the table. The cheapest heat is rarely the one being sold.
